messages.snippet: Hi James, Our records show 7.5 hours of unposted time for December. Please ensure all time is record
messages.subject: Reminder: December time entries due
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi James,

Our records show 7.5 hours of unposted time for December. Please ensure all time is recorded and released by 12:00 on 2 January so we can run the month-end and interim bills. Thank you.

Accounts
